thread:
Priya K.: Heads up — AcmeCorp (acct 8241) final invoice shows a $0.00 tax line but the dashboard metered tax total is $128. They hit month-end yesterday and finance flagged a mismatch. Can anyone quick-check?
Eli R.: can you paste the invoice id and the dashboard snapshot link?
Priya K.: invoice INV-2026-03-8241, dashboard snapshot: https://console.redwood/acct/8241/usage/2026-03-31
Sam T.: throwing this in here — did we run any tax reclassification backfills during cutoff? Those jobs sometimes run late.
Priya K.: Not that I know of. Finance says the dashboard shows tax on plan adjustments + prorations, invoice shows no tax line.
Jules (billing-bot): Automated export: monthly-invoice-snapshot INV-2026-03-8241 created at 1717209600. Metering export for acct 8241 available: s3://billing-exports/2026/03/8241-meter.csv
Eli R.: Ok running quick sql to compare metered_tax vs invoiced_tax for acct 8241:
```
SELECT sum(metered_tax) as metered, sum(invoiced_tax) as invoiced
FROM billing_metering
WHERE account_id = 8241 AND period = '2026-03';
```
Eli R.: results: metered=128.00, invoiced=0.00. So the discrepancy exists.
Sam T.: check jobs around snapshot time: looks like tax-reclass job started at 1717210500 and completed at 1717212600 — that overlaps after snapshot generation window.
Priya K.: oh — so snapshot ran at 1717209600 but reclass finished later, meaning dashboard (which reads latest metering) shows the updated tax, invoice captured earlier state.
Marta (Finance): Confirming — we saw a reclassification batch that moved $128 from adjustments into a tax category after snapshot. We usually lock reclassifications 1h before snapshot but this one started late due to retry.
Priya K.: Ugh. That explains the mismatch. Is there a fix we can do for AcmeCorp retroactively?
Sam T.: short-term: we can issue a credit for $128 and annotate invoice with a note referencing the post-snapshot reclassification. For long-term, need a hard lock and better retry throttle on reclass jobs during the finalization window.
Eli R.: I'll open a PR to add a coordination lock: `LOCK_MONTH_END_SNAPSHOT` that prevents reclass jobs from starting within 2h of snapshot. Also adding alert if job attempts to start in that window.
Priya K.: Sam, can you handle the credit and communication to customer? I'll draft the explanation for finance.
Sam T.: on it. Drafting email: "we identified a post-snapshot tax reclassification that updated dashboard totals after invoice snapshot; we will issue a $128 credit on INV-2026-03-8241 and update next statement."
Marta (Finance): please include the export rows and job run ids in the communication. We'll need it for audit.
Eli R.: created issue: GH#4571 — month-end reclass lock + alert. Assigning to infra and billing.
oncall-sre: FYI — I'll add an incident annotation to the month-end runbook so oncall sees the retry pattern next time.
Priya K.: Thanks all. Follow-ups: Sam will send credit + customer note (ETA 3h), Eli PR for lock (ETA EOD), Marta to confirm ledger adjustment (ETA EOD). I'll close loop once credit goes out. :thumbsup:
Sam T.: credit posted and email sent to AcmeCorp, included export link and job id. Marking resolved for this thread. :white_check_mark:
Marta (Finance): ledger adjustment scheduled, will appear in next reconciliation. Closing on finance side.
Priya K.: closing here — root cause: post-snapshot tax reclassification job completed after invoice snapshot. Remediation: lock reclass jobs near snapshot + alert.
Eli R.: noted, will link GH#4571 to runbook.
Jules (billing-bot): Note: monthly-invoice-snapshot INV-2026-03-8241 annotated with manual-credit-8241 at 1717214200."
